source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Core Rulebook v1.1 (Dark Weapon)

summary.value: You imbue a weapon with dark energy.

system.description: You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes dark. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
